evidence.observation: Title art with Play, How to Play and Quit; the harness arrow hovers Play then Quit.
evidence.riff: Three buttons and a one-line hint: the menu promises the goal before the briefing does.

evidence.observation: How to Play lists 9 controls, 7 rules and the controller layout.
evidence.riff: The same control list appears in three places: README, this screen and the pause menu.

evidence.observation: Back to Menu returns to the title.
evidence.riff: A plain round trip; no state is touched.

evidence.observation: Line 1 types out character by character, then shows ENTER / CLICK TO CONTINUE · ESC TO SKIP.
evidence.riff: Typing at 20 ms a character paces the reading without blocking it.

evidence.observation: Clicks on and above the dialogue panel do not advance the line (defect D-01).
evidence.riff: A full-screen shade ColorRect stops the mouse event before _unhandled_input sees it.

evidence.observation: Enter advances; Enter mid-line completes the line at once.
evidence.riff: Keyboard works, so the defect only bites mouse-first players.

evidence.observation: After line 8, Enter fades to arena 1.
evidence.riff: One fade, then the arena loads.

evidence.observation: D then A walks Mr. Block right and left with a tilt and dust.
evidence.riff: Acceleration differs on ground and in the air, so turns feel softer mid-jump.

evidence.observation: Space jumps.
evidence.riff: Extra gravity after 0.2 s makes the fall quicker than the rise.

evidence.observation: A second Space in mid-air re-launches him upward.
evidence.riff: One air jump, restored on landing.

evidence.observation: Holding Shift lifts him; the blue fuel bar drains.
evidence.riff: Fuel refills fast on the ground and slowly in the air.

evidence.observation: The gun follows the crosshair; held left click fires a ball every 0.4 s.
evidence.riff: Aim is the cursor, not the facing, so you can run one way and shoot the other.

evidence.observation: Right-click lobs a grenade: three blinks, then the blast.
evidence.riff: A fuse makes the grenade a placement decision, not a second gun.

evidence.observation: A chicken touch dims a health ball and flashes the player.
evidence.riff: Three health per life; contact is a distance check.

evidence.observation: Last health ball lost: fade to navy, "Ouch! 2 lives left", respawn at the gate.
evidence.riff: The gate is cleared of chickens before the respawn.

evidence.observation: A grenade kills four chickens in one frame: MEGA KILL!, kill counter 0 to 4.
evidence.riff: Same rule as the Unity audio manager: three or more in one frame window.

evidence.observation: Feathers, a dark-red splatter that fades, and screen shake on every death.
evidence.riff: The juice is all code: particles and tweens, no animation files.

evidence.observation: After 10 kills the egg counter still reads 1 / 5.
evidence.riff: The objective is eggs; the kill counter is only a score.

evidence.observation: Touching a nest: sparkle, +1 EGG, the counter ticks.
evidence.riff: Pickup is a 62 px radius, so a jump past a nest still counts.

evidence.observation: The fifth egg shows COURT CLEARED! with kills, eggs and lives.
evidence.riff: Remaining chickens burst into feathers so the win reads cleanly.

evidence.observation: Next Arena loads arena 2.
evidence.riff: Totals carry in the GameState autoload.

evidence.observation: Esc shows TIME OUT; Resume continues.
evidence.riff: The world node is pausable; the HUD and overlay keep processing.

evidence.observation: Pause → Main Menu returns to the title.
evidence.riff: Leaving mid-arena keeps the campaign position.

evidence.observation: The menu shows Continue: Arena 2; clicking it loads arena 2.
evidence.riff: Continue appears only while a campaign is active past arena 1.

evidence.observation: Sunset Rooftops: 3 pipes, orange tint, 6 eggs; cleared with 2 lives.
evidence.riff: More pipes and a faster spawn rate are the whole difficulty change.

evidence.observation: Fowl Play Finals: 4 pipes, navy tint, 7 eggs, 4-hit chickens; cleared on the last life.
evidence.riff: The closest the scripted run came to losing.

evidence.observation: The final card reads Claim the Trophy and opens the victory screen.
evidence.riff: Same overlay, different label on the last arena.

evidence.observation: CHAMPION! YOU KILLED: 013 · EGGS: 18, with Play Again and Main Menu.
evidence.riff: The totals are summed across arenas.

evidence.observation: Back at the menu, no Continue button.
evidence.riff: The victory screen finishes the campaign.

evidence.observation: Esc skips the briefing straight to arena 1.
evidence.riff: Returning players never have to read it again.

evidence.observation: Synthetic joypad events: left stick walks, right stick aims, RT fires, A jumps.
evidence.riff: Same actions as the keyboard, bound in code.

evidence.observation: Start pauses and resumes.
evidence.riff: Pause is one action with keyboard and pad bindings.

evidence.observation: R reloads the arena immediately.
evidence.riff: reload_current_scene: the cheapest possible restart.

evidence.observation: Walking into the flock without firing costs three lives with fade-respawns.
evidence.riff: Each life is three touches; invulnerability prevents instant chains.

evidence.observation: GAME OVER: THE FLOCK WON ARENA 1. RUN IT BACK?
evidence.riff: The defeat screen names the arena you lost.

evidence.observation: Retry Arena reloads arena 1 with three lives.
evidence.riff: Retry restarts the arena, not the campaign.

evidence.observation: Esc on How to Play returns to the menu.
evidence.riff: Esc is the universal back key.

evidence.observation: On a platform, S + Space falls through it to the ground.
evidence.riff: Platform collisions are switched off for 0.25 s.

evidence.observation: Held F fires; G throws a grenade.
evidence.riff: Keyboard-only play is possible.

evidence.observation: Pad LB throws a grenade; RB burns jetpack fuel.
evidence.riff: Every action has a pad binding.

evidence.observation: Pause → Restart Arena reloads the court.
evidence.riff: Same reload as the R key.

evidence.observation: Pause → Main Menu → Quit; the game process exits with code 0.
evidence.riff: The take ends just before the click; the exit code is the evidence.

not_exercised.reason: F11 / Alt+Enter toggle fullscreen in game_state.gd; not captured, because a mode change would break the fixed 3840x2160 capture window.
The victory screen's Play Again button starts a new campaign; not clicked (Main Menu was).
The defeat screen's Exit Game calls the same get_tree().quit as Quit; not clicked.
13 sounds and a music loop exist; game audio was not captured. The film carries narration only.
